name: Thailand Biennale
funding: 2025-26 edition: Ministry of Culture's Office of Contemporary Art and Culture with Phuket province; commissions co-funded by unnamed foundations.

name: Palais de Lomé
funding: Togolese state paid the XOF 2.2bn renovation and funds operations. Director Sonia Lawson sought sponsors in 2019. CFAO and Toyota Tsusho hosted an award show in June 2026.

name: Alice Yard
funding: Mellon Foundation USD 150,000 over 36 months (awarded February 2024). Nordic Culture Fund and OCA support residencies; co-rd Ltd and Basso Leonard Architects are listed supporters.

name: Bocas Lit Fest
funding: NGC, the state National Gas Company, was title sponsor through 2024. 2026 main sponsors: Ministry of Culture, JB Fernandes Trust, OCM; Massy and ANSA McAL foundations and Methanex also support.

name: B7L9 Art Centre
funding: Run by the Kamel Lazaar Foundation. Its undated partners page names the German Federal Foreign Office, EU delegation, Goethe-Institut, Pro Helvetia, Institut Français, Tunisair and the Tunisian Education Ministry.

name: B7L9 Art Centre (Kamel Lazaar Foundation)
funding: Opened 2019, funded by the Kamel Lazaar Foundation (money from Swicorp, a banking firm); partners include the EU, the German Foreign Office, Goethe, Pro Helvetia, Tunisair and Porticus.

name: Le 32Bis
funding: Private initiative. Funded by Tunisian private patrons who are not named. Partners include the African Culture Fund.

name: Musée National du Bardo
funding: A 2001 World Bank loan (~24M TND) and 9.5M TND from the state funded the 2009-12 expansion. TOTAL Tunisie, Loukil, ATUGE and Dar El Marsa backed the 2017 Louvre partnership.

name: Anadolu Kültür (Depo and Diyarbakır Arts Center)
funding: Founded 2002; runs Depo in Istanbul and the Diyarbakır Arts Center. Supporters named: Sigrid Rausing Trust, Civil Rights Defenders, Foundation for Arts Initiatives and Stiftung Mercator.

name: Borusan Contemporary
funding: Corporate museum of Borusan Holding, run by the Borusan Kocabıyık Foundation in the holding's headquarters. Group units: EnBW wind power, steel pipe, Caterpillar dealing, car sales.
